config.note: soft targets train-only; val/test masks hard. All other settings identical to the winner (trial 44, seed 2804).

interpretation: negative/neutral. Dilated-soft targets widen predictions (recall +0.8pp, precision -2.3pp, optimal threshold 0.45->0.62) and do not improve any metric: exact Dice -0.009, clDice -0.013, +-1px tolerant F1 -0.001 (tied). The boundary band is absorbed into wider predictions rather than sharpening localization; reported as a tested-and-rejected single-seed protocol variant, consistent with the boundary-placement-dominated error profile.
